summary: OpenText filed an 8-K announcing a conditional notice of redemption for $1.0 billion principal of its 6.900% Senior Secured Notes due 2027, with full redemption set for October 2, 2026, subject to a financing condition. Concurrently, the company is exploring a Rule 144A/Regulation S offering of new senior secured notes and seeking a Revolver Amendment to extend its revolving credit facility maturity. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The notice is conditional and definitive documentation for the revolver amendment remains pending. Watch for completion of the financing and any amendment terms.
